SURGICAL PATHOLOGY REPORT
Patient ID: PT-000304
Specimen: Core needle biopsy / surgical tissue resection of primary tumor.

GROSS & MICROSCOPIC EXAMINATION:
Specimen consists of multiple biopsy tissue cores demonstrating invasive malignant epithelial neoplasm consistent with NSCLC.
Histologic sections demonstrate moderate cellular atypia with hyperchromatic nuclei, prominent nucleoli, and desmoplastic stroma.
Surgical margins are evaluated and confirmed clear of invasive tumor cells. Lymphovascular invasion is not identified.

MOLECULAR & IMMUNOHISTOCHEMICAL TESTING:
Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS) confirms activating TP53 driver alteration.
Pathologic Stage: Morphologic evaluation consistent with clinical Stage III.
Recommendation: Correlation with systemic clinical oncology records and targeted therapy protocols.

SURGICAL PATHOLOGY REPORT
Patient ID: PT-000211
Specimen: Core needle biopsy / surgical tissue resection of primary tumor.

GROSS & MICROSCOPIC EXAMINATION:
Specimen consists of multiple fibrous tissue cores exhibiting invasive malignant epithelial neoplasm consistent with NSCLC.
Microscopic examination reveals moderate cellular atypia with hyperchromatic nuclei, prominent nucleoli, and desmoplastic stroma.
Surgical margins are evaluated and confirmed clear of invasive tumor cells. Lymphovascular invasion is not identified.

MOLECULAR & IMMUNOHISTOCHEMICAL TESTING:
Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS) confirms activating MET driver alteration.
Pathologic Stage: Morphologic evaluation consistent with clinical Stage III.
Recommendation: Correlation with patient oncology clinical chart and targeted therapy protocols.
